es: Escribir un informe breve con pregunta, muestra, resultados con proporción, una limitación y una conclusión prudente.

teaching.en: We asked one hundred students how many hours they sleep on school nights.
teaching.es: Preguntamos a cien estudiantes cuántas horas duermen las noches de colegio.
teaching.explanationEs: Pregunta y muestra: asked + personas, sin to. Se cuenta en pasado lo que hicisteis.
segments: We asked one hundred students how many
hours they sleep on school nights.
teaching.audioText: We asked one hundred students how many hours they sleep on school nights.

teaching.en: Among the respondents, nearly half sleep less than seven hours.
teaching.es: Entre los encuestados, casi la mitad duerme menos de siete horas.
teaching.explanationEs: Nearly half da la proporción sin la cifra exacta. Los hallazgos van en presente.
teaching.audioText: Among the respondents, nearly half sleep less than seven hours.

teaching.en: Twice as many girls as boys said they feel tired in class.
teaching.es: El doble de chicas que de chicos dijo que se siente cansado en clase.
teaching.explanationEs: Un comparativo proporcional resume la diferencia entre dos grupos.
segments: Twice as many girls as boys
said they feel tired in class.
teaching.audioText: Twice as many girls as boys said they feel tired in class.

teaching.en: However, the main limitation is that all the respondents study at the same school.
teaching.es: Sin embargo, la limitación principal es que todos los encuestados estudian en el mismo colegio.
teaching.explanationEs: However + the main limitation is that … anuncia el punto débil del estudio.
segments: However, the main limitation is that all
the respondents study at the same school.
teaching.audioText: However, the main limitation is that all the respondents study at the same school.

teaching.en: The results suggest that late phone use may affect sleep, but more research is needed.
teaching.es: Los resultados sugieren que usar el móvil tarde puede afectar al sueño, pero hace falta más investigación.
teaching.explanationEs: Suggest + may cierra con una conclusión prudente; more research is needed admite que aún no es definitiva.
segments: The results suggest that late phone use may
affect sleep, but more research is needed.
teaching.audioText: The results suggest that late phone use may affect sleep, but more research is needed.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Preguntamos a cincuenta alumnos sobre sus horas de sueño.»

answer.text: We asked fifty students about their hours of sleep

feedback.es: Ask con personas no lleva preposición; about introduce el tema.

hint.es: Después de asked va directamente el número de alumnos.

prompt.es: Completa: «Casi la mitad de los encuestados duerme poco.»

feedback.es: Nearly half o almost half expresan una proporción cercana a la mitad, sin dar la cifra exacta.

origin.text: ___ half of the respondents sleep very little.

choices.text: However, the main limitation is that all the respondents are my friends.
However, the main result is that all the respondents are my friends.
However, the main limitation is that some respondents are my friends.

feedback.es: El límite es que todos son amigos, no algunos, y se llama limitation, no result.

hint.es: Fíjate en la palabra que nombra el límite y en cuántos encuestados son amigos.

origin.text: Quieres reconocer una limitación: todos los encuestados son amigos tuyos.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase describe ese resultado con una proporción?

choices.text: The majority of the respondents sleep less than seven hours.
Nearly half of the respondents sleep less than seven hours.
A quarter of the respondents sleep less than seven hours.

feedback.es: Cuarenta y cinco de cien está cerca de la mitad sin llegar: nearly half. La mayoría exigiría más de 50 y un cuarto serían 25.

origin.text: Resultado: 45 de 100 alumnos duermen menos de siete horas.

prompt.es: Completa: «Pero la muestra es pequeña: esa es la limitación principal.»

feedback.es: La limitation es el punto débil del estudio y se anuncia con However + the main limitation.

origin.text: However, the sample is small: that is the main ___.

prompt.es: Compara a chicas y chicos con twice as many.

answer.text: Twice as many girls as boys feel tired in class.
accepted: Twice as many girls as boys feel tired in class.
Twice as many girls as boys say they feel tired in class.

feedback.es: Treinta es el doble de quince: twice as many + grupo mayor + as + grupo menor.

origin.text: Datos: 30 chicas y 15 chicos dicen que están cansados en clase.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué muestra la encuesta sobre las pantallas.

choices.text: Most of them use screens for less than an hour a day.
Half of them never use screens.
Most of them use screens for more than an hour a day.

feedback.es: Solo un cuarto usa pantallas menos de una hora; por tanto, la mayoría las usa más de una hora al día.

origin.audio: We asked forty teenagers about screen time. Only a quarter use screens for less than one hour a day.

prompt.es: ¿Qué conclusión del informe es la más prudente?

choices.text: The results suggest that sleeping less may affect marks.
The results prove that sleeping less lowers marks.
The results show that all students sleep less.

feedback.es: Suggest con may deja abierta la posibilidad; proves afirma una causa que una encuesta no puede demostrar.

origin.text: Quieres concluir con prudencia: la encuesta sugiere que dormir poco puede afectar a las notas.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Hace falta más investigación para confirmar los resultados.»

answer.text: More research is needed to confirm the results

feedback.es: More research is needed cierra el informe admitiendo que la conclusión aún es provisional.

prompt.es: Escribe tu informe con los datos dados, de 70 a 170 palabras.

answer.text: We asked fifty students at our school how many hours they sleep on school nights. Nearly half of the respondents, twenty-two students, sleep less than seven hours. Twice as many girls as boys said they feel tired in class: sixteen girls and eight boys. However, the main limitation is that we asked students from only one school, so the results may be different in other schools. The sample is also small. In conclusion, the results suggest that sleeping less may make students feel tired, but more research is needed to be sure.
accepted: We asked fifty students at our school how many hours they sleep on school nights. Nearly half of the respondents, twenty-two students, sleep less than seven hours. Twice as many girls as boys said they feel tired in class: sixteen girls and eight boys. However, the main limitation is that we asked students from only one school, so the results may be different in other schools. The sample is also small. In conclusion, the results suggest that sleeping less may make students feel tired, but more research is needed to be sure.

We asked fifty students from our school about their sleep on school nights. Almost half of them, twenty-two students, sleep less than seven hours. Twice as many girls as boys feel tired in class: sixteen girls and eight boys. However, the main limitation is that we only asked one school, so the results may not be the same in other schools. Our sample is small too. To sum up, the results suggest that less sleep may make students tired, but more research is needed.

feedback.es: Un buen informe incluye pregunta y muestra, un resultado con proporción, una comparación, una limitación y una conclusión prudente.

origin.text: Pregunta: ¿cuántas horas duermes las noches de colegio? Muestra: 50 alumnos de tu colegio. Resultado: 22 duermen menos de siete horas. Comparación: 16 chicas y 8 chicos se sienten cansados en clase. Limitación: solo encuestaste a un colegio. Conclusión prudente: dormir poco puede cansar, pero hace falta más investigación.

prompt.es: Completa: «Los resultados sugieren que los deberes pueden afectar al sueño.»

feedback.es: Suggest + that + may presenta la conclusión como posibilidad; con results el verbo va sin -s.

origin.text: The results ___ that homework may affect sleep.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase del informe está bien escrita?

choices.text: We asked to fifty students about their habits.
We asked fifty students about their habits.
We asked fifty students about of their habits.

feedback.es: Ask + personas va sin preposición, y about va sin of.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué limitación menciona el audio.

choices.text: Too many students said they sleep well.
The survey did not ask about sleep.
All the respondents belong to one group.

feedback.es: El audio dice que todos venían de la misma clase: la muestra no representa a otros alumnos.

origin.audio: Twenty students said they sleep well and forty said they do not. However, everybody came from the same class.
